calls.statement:
WITH base AS (
 SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02')
SELECT 'dup_content' k, count(*)::VARCHAR v FROM (SELECT receipt_id, product_key, sale_ts_utc, quantity, net_amount FROM base GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'ts_date_mismatch', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM base WHERE CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE)<>sale_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_units', coalesce(sum(r.quantity_returned),0)::VARCHAR FROM fact_return_line r JOIN base b ON b.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_in_period_units', coalesce(sum(r.quantity_returned),0)::VARCHAR FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL SELECT 'zero_amount_lines', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM base WHERE net_amount<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'in_stg_not_fact_ids', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM stg_sales_line_load t WHERE t.sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM base)
UNION ALL SELECT 'loaded_range', min(etl_loaded_at)::VARCHAR||' / '||max(etl_loaded_at)::VARCHAR FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'daily_units', string_agg(sale_date::VARCHAR||':'||u, ', ' ORDER BY sale_date) FROM (SELECT sale_date, sum(quantity) u FROM base GROUP BY 1)

SELECT 'rpt_units_all_cats' k, sum(units_sold)::VARCHAR v FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_units_all_cats', sum(f.quantity)::VARCHAR FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_units_all_cats_excl_staff', sum(f.quantity)::VARCHAR FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=108 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL SELECT 'nontrading_days_with_sales', string_agg(d.calendar_date::VARCHAR||' '||coalesce(d.holiday_name,''), ', ') FROM dim_date d WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND NOT d.is_trading_day
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_date_range_check', min(calendar_date)::VARCHAR||'..'||max(calendar_date)::VARCHAR||' n='||count(*) FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=3
UNION ALL SELECT 'interior_paint_other_store_keys_for_108', string_agg(DISTINCT store_key::VARCHAR, ',') FROM dim_store WHERE store_id=108
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_wrong_name', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date>=DATE '2026-06-29' AND (f.sale_date<p.valid_from OR f.sale_date>p.valid_to)
